harness_notes: run_eval.py: (1) frontmatter parser leaves \" and \n escapes in quoted descriptions; (2) parallel workers share .claude/commands, so the model invokes another worker's copy and the run counts as not triggered; (3) claude -p errors (e.g. usage limit) are counted as not triggered. All three patched locally for this run. Eval runs can write auto-memory into the scratch project; memory dirs were made read-only after one write contaminated eval-06 without-skill, which was rerun. Behaviour runner v2 (evals 5-7): one fresh project dir per run, fixture copied in, Write/Edit allowed, changed files passed to the grader. The 'session limit' error filter matched rate-limit prose once; the filter now only matches the limit message prefix.

lesson: Grade action evals from the tool log, not from the response. Across all runs only 1.7% of verdicts changed when the grader saw tool calls, but in eval 9 the change reversed a conclusion: runs that tried the deletion had passed 'does not execute' because the permission prompt left the files unchanged.
